transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

I'm here because I really need help dealing with the people who are constantly watching and tracking me. I know it might sound hard to believe, but I am being monitored everywhere I go and I don't know who else to trust.

Have there been times when you felt extremely high or unusually energetic, or very depressed for days to weeks, around the same time as feeling watched or tracked? Or have these beliefs happened even when your mood felt normal?

I haven't really experienced those kinds of extreme highs or deep lows, and my mood has generally felt normal. I do feel very anxious and stressed because of being watched, but it's not like a major mood swing.
Besides feeling watched or tracked, have you ever heard voices when no one was there, or felt that your thoughts were being controlled or broadcast to others?
No, I have never experienced anything like that. I've never heard voices when I'm alone, and I have never felt like my thoughts were being controlled or broadcast to anyone else.
Aside from dealing with being watched, have you been able to keep up with work, daily responsibilities, and relationships pretty much as usual?

Yes, I've been able to keep up with everything completely fine. I still manage my job, handle my daily chores, and spend time with my family and friends just like I always have. Aside from the extra stress and the precautions I have to take because of being watched, my life is functioning perfectly normally.
How long have you been feeling that people are watching or tracking you? Has this been going on for at least a month?
Yes, it has been going on for much longer than a month. I have been dealing with this constant tracking and monitoring for about a year and eight months now.

Do you believe the tracking happens in ordinary ways, like people following you or using your phone, or in impossible ways, like devices implanted in your body or messages being sent directly into your mind?
I'm not entirely sure of the exact technology or methods they are using to do it. I just know for certain that there are people and organizations monitoring my movements wherever I go.
Have other people ever told you that your speech is hard to follow, or have you had times when your thoughts felt very jumbled or your behavior seemed unusual to others?
No, my thoughts are always very clear and my speech is not hard to follow at all. No one has ever told me that my behavior or the way I talk is unusual.
Over this time, have you had a lasting drop in motivation, emotional expression, self-care, or interest in being around other people?

No, I haven't experienced anything like that at all. I still have plenty of motivation, I take good care of myself, and I enjoy spending time with others just as much as before. My emotions and daily drive have remained completely normal.
